verticalFlowSummary: All Y math below is in unscaled (pre-#Scale#=1.7) authoring units; Rainmeter applies TransformationMatrix=1.7;0;0;1.7;1.7;1.7 uniformly to every text/bar meter at render time (scale 1.7, then translate +1.7,+1.7 device px), while the background Shape meter bakes '*Scale' directly into its own path formulas. Per Rainmeter semantics, Y=nR/Y=nr resolve against the previous NON-HIDDEN meter in file order (a meter with Hidden=1 is skipped as a positional reference for meters after it), which is exactly why the '((#VAR#=1) ? offset : 0)R' idiom used on every hidden channel successfully collapses their vertical footprint to zero regardless of their own (non-zero) auto-text-height. Given the active config (CHA1=1, CHA2=1, everything else=0), the resolved flow is: (1) meterTitle at absolute Y=9, H=20 ('FANS' title). (2) Chassis1Label at absolute Y=32 (=TopMarginFormula); Chassis1rpm and Chassis1Percentage share that same Y=32 via their '_r' style variants (Y=r => same row, just X-aligned Left/Center/Right = 7/103/197). (3) Chassis1Bar sits at Y = 32 + H_text(Chassis1Percentage) (0R from the previous meter's bottom), H=1, W=188 starting X=8. (4) Chassis2Label at Y = Chassis1Bar.Y + 1(bar H) + 1(RowSpacing) = Chassis1Bar.Y + 2; Chassis2rpm/Chassis2Percentage share that Y via 'r'. (5) Chassis2Bar at Y = Chassis2Label.Y + H_text(Chassis2Percentage) (0R). (6) Chassis3..Psu (11 channel-groups, 44 meters) are all Hidden=1 in this configuration and contribute nothing to the flow -- they are transcribed in full above (measures+meters) for completeness/future-toggling, but a renderer targeting only the current configuration can simply skip them. (7) MeterBackgroundHeight's Y (used by StyleBackground as the panel's total content height) = Chassis2Bar.Y + 1(bar H) + 11 (=BottomMargin 3 + BgOffset 5 + 3), i.e. the background hugs the bottom of the FRONT row's bar by 12 unscaled px, matching the tight 2-row panel in the reference screenshot ('BACK 1200 rpm 60%' / 'FRONT 1109 rpm 55%'). H_text(...) denotes the auto-computed single-line text height of an un-sized STRING meter (Trebuchet MS, size 8, Bold for *Percentage/*Label, Normal for *rpm) -- this is a genuine font-metrics dependency (Rainmeter measures it internally, sharpened by the skin-level AccurateText=1 flag) that the Direct2D port must reproduce via its own text-layout engine (e.g. DirectWrite TextLayout metrics for 'Trebuchet MS' Bold/Regular at 8 device-independent units) rather than a hard-coded constant; a rough sanity-check estimate is ~9-11 unscaled px per row, giving a ballpark total unscaled panel height around 64-70px (~109-119px after the 1.7x scale), but this MUST be verified against actual measured text metrics, not assumed.
notes: GPU1FanMeasure (line ~263 of Fans.ini) reads '#HWiNFO-FANS-GPU0-SensorId/SensorInstance/EntryId#' -- these variables do not exist in HWiNFO.inc (only GPU1 and GPU2 variants are defined there). Currently harmless because GPU1=0 (measure Disabled=1), but flagged as an authoring bug.

GPU2FanMeasure (line ~291) reads '#HWiNFO-FANS-GPU1-*#' (GPU1's sensor triple: 0xe0002000/0x0/0x1000000) instead of the properly-defined 'HWiNFO-FANS-GPU2-*' (0xf5000650/0x0/0x3000000, which ends up unused/orphaned). An off-by-one paired with the previous bug. Currently harmless because GPU2=0.

CHA4, CHA5, FAN21, FAN22, PUMP1, WPUMP1 and PSU all resolve to the identical HWiNFO sensor triple 0xf5000650/0x0/0x3000000 (the template's placeholder PSU-fan header) -- these are meant to be customized per the user's actual hardware sensor IDs and are not wired to distinct physical fan headers out of the box. All are Hidden=1 in the current config regardless.

Chassis1Bar's Hidden-state Y fallback branch is literally '1' ('...: 1)R') while every other channel's Bar fallback is '0' -- a minor copy/paste inconsistency in the source skin. It has no observable effect: the true-branch (CHA1=1) is what's active today, and even if toggled off, Hidden meters are skipped as R/r reference points for subsequent meters (see verticalFlowSummary), so the specific fallback number is moot either way.

The background panel's outer 1px frame (Shape7 in StyleBackground, stroke color 96,138,203 @ alpha100) is authored with StrokeWidth = #Stroke_Width# * #Scale#, and the global Stroke_Width variable = 0 in Variables.inc for this (standard/non-'recovery') theme -- so the frame currently renders with a literal 0-width stroke, i.e. it is defined but NOT visibly drawn. Only the parallel 'r'-prefixed variable set (rStroke_Width=1, rStrokeColor=172,172,172, etc.) would produce a visible border; that set is not what's active for this skin instance.
Chassis1rpm explicitly restates FontColor=#colorText2#,#colorText2Alpha# even though styleSecondaryText already sets the identical value -- redundant but harmless; called out only for faithfulness.

Percentage meters (*Percentage) rely on the STRING meter default NumOfDecimals=0 (not explicitly set), whereas *rpm meters explicitly set NumOfDecimals=0 (redundant with the default). Net displayed precision is identical (integer) either way.
PsuRpm is capitalized 'PsuRpm' (capital R) while every other channel's rpm meter is lower-case ('...rpm') -- purely a naming inconsistency, no functional effect.

[Rainmeter] Update=1000 drives the base 1000ms polling interval for the raw HWiNFO Plugin measures (no UpdateDivider set on them = divider 1). Each *PercentCalc / *UsageBarWarn Calc measure carries UpdateDivider=-1, meaning it never polls on its own timer and instead only recomputes when explicitly told to via the parent Plugin measure's OnChangeAction ('!UpdateMeasure') -- i.e. percent/bar-color values update precisely in lockstep with (and only when) the underlying HWiNFO sensor value changes, not on a fixed cadence.

Bar color logic (identical across all 13 channels): *UsageBarWarn = 'PercentCalc > 75 ? -1 : -2', Substitute '-1'->'220,20,60,200' (crimson warn), '-2'->'#colorBar#' = '93,141,172,255' (steel blue default). The corresponding *Bar meter's BarColor references this measure by name (e.g. BarColor=[Chassis1UsageBarWarn]), so the bar tints crimson above 75% fan speed and steel-blue otherwise.

Percent formula pattern (identical across all 13 channels): PercentCalc = RawRpmMeasure * 100 / (MaxXxxFanSpeed + 0.000001); the '+0.000001' guards against divide-by-zero when the configured Max speed is 0/blank. With MaxCha1FanSpeed=MaxCha2FanSpeed=2000, the screenshot's 'BACK 1200 rpm 60%' / 'FRONT 1109 rpm 55%' don't perfectly reconcile via this exact formula (1200/2000=60% matches exactly; 1109/2000=55.45%, displayed as '55%' after Calc measure integer formatting) -- both are consistent with the documented formula given standard truncation/rounding of the Calc measure's string output.

The 'GraphAutoscale', StyleGraph/StyleHalfLengthGraph* / StyleHorizontalLine / StyleBarSignal styles listed among the 'GLOBAL STYLES' in the task prompt are NOT used anywhere in Fans.ini (this panel has no graphs or divider lines) -- included in globalStyles purely for catalog completeness where referenced by the prompt.

[Rainmeter] AccurateText=1 and DynamicWindowSize=1 are skin-wide options relevant to reproducing exact auto-sized STRING-meter heights (see verticalFlowSummary) and to the panel's overall window auto-sizing behavior, respectively.

Interactive/non-visual behavior present in the file but out of scope for the static visual spec: MiddleMouseDownAction=[!Refresh]; hover reveals the settings gear (Controls group) via MouseOverAction/MouseLeaveAction; right-click context menu offers 'Rainformer settings' and 'Launcher' entries that activate other configs.
